notes: Job Agent 3.0.6 beta improves visibility into search-only outcomes without relaxing recruitment qualification rules. After the user's 3.0.5 run (180 discovered; 108 enriched; 106 scored; 36 kept; 0 ready) and observed processed history increase from 42 to 45, this release prints category diagnostics for Data/BI, IT Support, QA and Other at discovery, enrichment selection, full scoring, APPLY/REVIEW eligible pool, final shortlist and ready-to-prepare list. This allows us to distinguish low supply and prior submissions from scoring over-filtering without inventing candidate experience. When there are no APPLY matches, safe manual-review suggestions diversify across Data/BI, QA, IT Support when available, while retaining hard-experience, evidence, Prague location, and supported-source guards. No changes to scoring thresholds, role-based CV choice, Gmail permissions, history, automatic submission protections or final manual Submit. Offline regression suite: 132 tests passing; run the app in SEARCH_ONLY to examine the new stage counts.
